pain_point: Want to own not rent for retirement - I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income
headline_outcome: Own It Now. Lease It Later.
primary_text: "I want to own the property so when I retire I can lease it out as passive income." That's not just smart — it's the most common reason owner-occupiers buy instead of rent. Use the warehouse for your business now. Pay it off over 15-20 years. When you're ready to step back, lease it out and collect rent as passive income — potentially $30,000–$60,000 a year in Melbourne's west. These off-the-plan Truganina warehouses are in a high-demand industrial corridor near the Princes Freeway. Industrial tenants are plentiful and vacancy rates are tight. Build your retirement plan into your business premises. It starts with ownership.
description: Industrial warehouses in Melbourne's west can lease for $30,000-$60,000 per year
